Sphere Of Annihilation obliterates everything it touches - DC 18 Intelligence check to control it.

GMs: Identify a DC 18 Intelligence check moment to control the Sphere and bypass a deadly encounter entirely.

Run Quickling as a moral-choice encounter: they can protect everyone, or finish the objective before the cost spikes.

DMs: Make them choose - secure the objective or save the villagers as Quicklings exploit their 120-foot speed to wreak havoc.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Large Scorpion's poison is more potent than expected - 1d6 damage with a DC 12 Fort save to negate.

Judges: Pin the scorpion in a tight corridor to exploit its 30' movement and force those DC 12 poison saves.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Nine Lives Stealer's instant kill potential only triggers on a natural 20 - DC 15 Constitution save required.

DMs: Save the Nine Lives Stealer's charges for when a creature with fewer than 100 HP fails the DC 15 Constitution save.

Ability Score Loss can disable a character entirely - hitting 0 in any score has catastrophic effects.

Judges: Have a ghoul drain 2 Strength to show them how quickly immobility becomes a real threat.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Cleric spells hinge on divine favor - every failed spell check adds 1 point of deity disapproval.

Judges: Remind them every failed spell check adds to disapproval; their deity's patience isn't infinite, and neither is their luck.

Saving Throws often surprise DMs - check order of operations before adjudicating.

DMs: Announce the saving throw before damage or effects - 6 Saving Throws, remember - avoiding disputes by sticking to the sequence.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

DMs: Use a 9th-level slot for Mass Suggestion to control campaign dynamics for 366 days, not just for a quick fix.
